**Chinese name:** 北京君正集成电路股份有限公司 (Běijīng Jūnzhèng)

::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
The closest thing China has to a global automotive/industrial memory design house — 82.7% of revenue is overseas and ISSI qualifies with world carmakers, precisely the niche US Dec-2024 rules tried to fence. The DRAM supercycle fully monetized in H1 2026 (interim, 28 August): revenue ¥39.57亿 (+76.0%) and net profit ¥11.98亿 (+489.6%), Q2 ¥23.97亿/¥8.79亿; storage line +90.1% to ¥26.32亿, compute +72.7%, gross margin 51.8%. DRAM contract re-pricing began Q1 and continued after July, with the company expecting tight supply until H2 2027 — but the 3D DRAM AI-bandwidth tape-out has slipped on the very capacity crunch it profits from. An A+H route opened: H-share application refiled 26 May 2026 with CSRC overseas-listing备案 received 24 June. FY2025 ¥47.41亿 (+12.5%).
:::

## What does this firm design?

Car-grade SRAM/DRAM/NOR/eMMC, RISC/MIPS AIoT-video SoCs, automotive LED drivers and LIN/CAN transceivers.
